description: Assign the conserved exposed patch to inter-cysteine loops and test whether it sits distal to the disulfide core (finger-tip face)
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
human=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P26436.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n',1)[1].replace('\n','')
def lu(s):
    cs=[i for i,c in enumerate(s) if c=='C']
    if len(cs)<10: return None
    cs=cs[-10:]
    if [cs[i+1]-cs[i] for i in range(9)]!=[3,9,7,8,18,4,16,1,6]: return None
    if cs[0]-4<0 or cs[-1]+4>len(s): return None
    return s[cs[0]-4:cs[-1]+4], cs[0]-4
hdom,hoff=lu(human); HSTART=hoff+1
txt=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={'query':'(gene:ACRV1) AND (taxonomy_id:40674)','format':'fasta','size':500},timeout=120).text
seen={}
for blk in txt.split('>')[1:]:
    h,s=blk.split('\n',1); s=s.replace('\n','')
    org=re.search(r'OS=(.+?) OX=',h); org=org.group(1) if org else '?'
    v=lu(s)
    if v and len(v[0])==len(hdom): seen.setdefault(org,v[0])
aln=np.array([list(v) for v in seen.values()]); NSP=len(aln)
ent=np.array([-(lambda p:(p*np.log2(p)).sum())(np.unique(aln[:,j],return_counts=True)[1]/NSP) for j in range(80)])
cons=1-ent/np.log2(20)
pdb=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P26436-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for l in pdb.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        rn=int(l[22:26])
        if HSTART<=rn<=HSTART+79:
            rows.append((rn,l[12:16].strip(),(l[76:78].strip() or 'C'),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
at=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['res','name','el','x','y','z'])
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}; r=at.el.map(RAD).fillna(1.7).values
X=at[['x','y','z']].values; PR=1.4
k=np.arange(200)+0.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*k/200); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
U=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=2); sasa=np.zeros(len(X))
for i in range(len(X)):
    Ri=r[i]+PR; pts=X[i]+Ri*U; acc=np.ones(200,bool)
    for j in np.where((D[i]<Ri+r+PR)&(np.arange(len(X))!=i))[0]:
        acc &= np.linalg.norm(pts-X[j],axis=1)>=r[j]+PR
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*Ri**2*acc.mean()
at['sasa']=sasa
MAX={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
     'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
df=pd.DataFrame({'res':np.arange(HSTART,HSTART+80),'aa':list(hdom),'cons':cons})
df['rsasa']=df.res.map(at.groupby('res').sasa.sum()).values/df.aa.map(MAX)
cen=at.groupby('res')[['x','y','z']].mean(); df[['cx','cy','cz']]=cen.loc[df.res].values
df['exposed']=df.rsasa>0.25
df['patch']=(df.exposed)&(df.cons>=0.95)

CYS=[190,193,202,209,217,235,239,255,256,262]
# disulfide core centroid = SG atoms of the 5 bonds
sg=at[(at.name=='SG')][['x','y','z']].values; core=sg.mean(0)
df['d_core']=np.linalg.norm(df[['cx','cy','cz']].values-core,axis=1)
# loop assignment from the cysteine ladder
def loop(res):
    for i in range(len(CYS)-1):
        if CYS[i]<res<CYS[i+1]: return "C%d-C%d"%(CYS[i],CYS[i+1])
    return "terminal"
df['loop']=df.res.map(loop)
print("patch residues by inter-cysteine loop:")
print(df[df.patch].groupby('loop').agg(n=('res','size'),residues=('res',lambda v:list(v))).to_string())

pa=df[df.patch].d_core; oe=df[(df.exposed)&(~df.patch)].d_core
t,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(pa,oe,alternative='greater')
d=(pa.mean()-oe.mean())/np.sqrt((pa.var(ddof=1)*(len(pa)-1)+oe.var(ddof=1)*(len(oe)-1))/(len(pa)+len(oe)-2))
print("\ndistance from disulfide-core centroid:")
print("  patch        n=%2d  %.2f +/- %.2f A"%(len(pa),pa.mean(),pa.std()))
print("  other exposed n=%2d  %.2f +/- %.2f A"%(len(oe),oe.mean(),oe.std()))
print("  Mann-Whitney (patch > other) p=%.4f, Cohen d=%.2f"%(p,d))
print("\nmax distance from core across whole domain: %.1f A (residue %d)"%(df.d_core.max(),df.res[df.d_core.idxmax()]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
a=ax[0]
cols={'C193-C202':'tab:blue','C202-C209':'tab:orange','C209-C217':'tab:green','C217-C235':'tab:red',
      'C235-C239':'tab:purple','C239-C255':'tab:brown','C190-C193':'tab:gray','C256-C262':'tab:pink','terminal':'k'}
for lp,g in df.groupby('loop'):
    a.scatter(g.d_core,g.cons,label=lp,c=cols.get(lp,'k'),s=40+180*g.rsasa,alpha=.85)
a.scatter(df.cx[df.patch]*0+df.d_core[df.patch],df.cons[df.patch],facecolors='none',edgecolors='crimson',s=230,lw=1.5)
a.set_xlabel('distance from disulfide-core centroid (A)'); a.set_ylabel('conservation')
a.legend(fontsize=7,ncol=2); a.set_title('Conserved exposed patch sits distal to the core\npatch %.1f A vs other exposed %.1f A, p = %.3f'%(pa.mean(),oe.mean(),p))
a=ax[1]
a.bar(df.res,df.d_core,color=np.where(df.patch,'crimson',np.where(df.exposed,'lightgrey','steelblue')),width=.9)
for c in CYS: a.plot(c,0.5,'v',c='goldenrod',ms=6)
a.set_xlabel('residue (human P26436)'); a.set_ylabel('distance from disulfide core (A)')
a.set_title('Red = invariant and exposed, gold = cysteines')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.round(3).to_csv('acrv1_lu_patch_table.tsv',sep='\t',index=False)
print("\nPATCH SEQUENCE CONTEXT")
for lp,g in df[df.patch].groupby('loop'):
    print("  %-12s %s"%(lp,' '.join('%s%d'%(a_,r_) for a_,r_ in zip(g.aa,g.res))))
